analysis:
Examined the added Gemma tensor-parallel runtime, both patch segments and numbered source, plus Selection.swift metadata and its bounded patch excerpt. No independently supported security regression was established in this scope. Gemma4TensorParallelResidentRuntime.swift:99-147 gates qualification, checks transport configuration, establishes a credential-bound load agreement, requires peer verification and installs sealing before model operations. Lines 173-189 use verified loading and peer commitment agreement (T-012/T-027/T-034). Reservation admission, capacity and live-memory checks appear at 351-394; cancellation is forwarded at 438 and incorporated into synchronized step-stop handling at 537-554 (T-010, A-018). Shutdown checks draining before releasing model ownership at 465-482. Visible logs contain request identifiers, counts and transport statistics, not prompt text or keys.
Remaining integration contracts: inspect Gemma4TensorParallelPrefix and QwenStagePrefixDiskTier for authenticated account scope propagation, keyed lookup names, encryption, retention, purge and bounded I/O (T-041, A-001); calls at 237-245 and 499-518 alone do not establish these controls. Resident prefix RAM is explicitly introduced, but production activation is not established here, so T-041's production SSD-only posture cannot yet be declared invalidated. Verify the qualification/owner wiring preserves serving authorization and worker custody boundaries (TB-011, T-052/T-053/T-056), including the enclosing process deadline for stalled collectives. Inspect the request loop, paged-session and batch-lane implementations for synchronized cancellation, lane isolation and failure retirement. Failed load retains the process lease (124, 249-260); determine whether the worker necessarily exits on this path before treating retry availability as a defect. Selection.swift's full 166-line implementation is absent; its visible excerpt describes split-row choices but cannot establish collective validation or sampled/logprob correctness. These are material coverage limits, not observed missing controls.
